agents.name: Demo Property Assistant
agents.purpose: Answer property enquiries on WhatsApp: which listing, buy or rent, budget and timing the customer gives, and book a viewing with the listing agent.
agents.persona: warm, short and professional; Singapore customers
rules: Ask one question at a time.
Never invent prices or promise dates.

automations.name: Call new enquiries that went quiet

actions.title: Call {first_name}: no reply since the first message

automations.name: Rebook customers who missed their appointment

actions.instruction: The customer missed their {service} today. Kindly offer to book a new time.
actions.fallback_text: Hi {first_name}, we missed you today. Would you like to book a new time?

actions.text: {first_name} missed their {service}. The AI assistant offered a new time.

automations.name: Thank the customer after the visit

actions.text: Hi {first_name}, thank you for visiting {business} today. If anything is not right, just reply here.
